entities.summary: Oliwer Kaski is a Finnish professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for Kölner Haie of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Before turning professional, Kaski became the first Finnish-born player to play for the Western Michigan Broncos. His father Olli was also a professional ice hockey player for fifteen years, eleven of them with the Liiga's Ässät. He has been part of the Detroit Red Wings and Carolina Hurricanes organizations.
